# azuremaxxing
> The Field Guide to Getting Maximum Value from Every Azure Dollar.

## Overview
azuremaxxing is an open field guide and FinOps optimization engine for Microsoft Azure.
It covers the three levers of Azure optimization:
1. Rate Optimization (Reservations, Savings Plans, Spot, MACC, Credits)
2. Usage Optimization (Orphan cleanup, Rightsizing, Auto-shutdown, Storage lifecycle, Observability trimming)
3. License Optimization (Azure Hybrid Benefit, Dev/Test subscriptions, SQL Edition sizing, ESU via Arc)

## Critical Deadlines
- February 1, 2027: Reservation exchanges end for savings-plan-covered services.
- January 12, 2027: Windows Server 2016 reaches end of extended support (ESUs available via Azure Arc).
- July 12, 2027: SQL Server 2014 ESU period ends.
- Past: SQL Server 2016 EOS (July 14, 2026), Windows Server 2012/2012 R2 ESU end (October 13, 2026).
